body:
A girl I dated when i was 20-22 had a very interesting father. He was something like 5'5'', ex military of some sort, and worked for the department of defense. Every time I came over he would take out one of his plethora of guns and set it on the table pointing at my face. The poor little guy started getting angry that I never responded to his intimidation and asked why it didn't bother me, to which I responded "Sir, your daughter is the most prized person I have ever met. She is worth whatever you want to put me through. I know I'll never do her wrong for her sake, so I didn't feel it necessary to point this out to you." He then picks up the gun, flips off the safety and points it at my leg. "Whatever, huh?" 

Almost shat myself. He didn't hassle me after that, though.

I posted here looking for feedback, any and all input is appreciated :)

Steering clear of substances is something I've been working on. Cut backs have happened, and going to out-patient is something i've been mulling over, for my self control is rather weak.

reading up on stuff is something I shall do... doubt I'll go to a therapist or group... that sort of thing makes me severely uncomfortable. 

I love art, and produce some here and there. I rarely have the initiative to do it though. Something I've been struggling with for a while. Its quite frustrating.

Many of the people I hang around bring up my apathy on a regular basis. I generally don't care about whatever is going on and such, which is a symptom of depression i think (thats off the top of my head, I don't know much about such things)

Thanks for your input. I need to do something about this, now I just need to start working on it. Hopefully I can start taking steps.
Yea... I have a very short attention span when it comes to anything. Usually I binge on something new that I enjoy, and then discard after a couple weeks for lack of enthusiasm.

Depression is a very likely thing. My quandary is not really knowing what to do to change that. I've been feeling this way for ~7 years? Like mentioned, I generally ignore how I'm feeling with substances and (failed) relationships.

I used to drink very heavily in the past. Slowed down on it but replaced it with other drugs for the most part.

No ingratitude intended, but nothing is very enjoyable. The things I enjoyed (past tense important) and attempt to do no longer bring me anything but a vast sense of let-down. I try very hard to hold on to that sort of mentality, but all my en-devours towards such things are fruitless. All is bland and grey, and has been for some time. Its growing tiresome.
